name: Dual-Branch Hash Encoder NeRF for Stylization
aliases: Dual-Branch Hash Encoder NeRF for Stylization — Instant Photorealistic Neural Radiance Fields Stylization method, Two-branch Instant-NGP
Instant Photorealistic Neural Radiance Fields Stylization method
definition: A neural radiance field architecture for simultaneous novel view synthesis and stylization of two scenes (content and style). It solves the problem of transferring style from a target scene/image to a content scene while preserving geometry, using an efficient hash encoder instead of a standard MLP for position encoding.
summary: Dual-Branch Hash Encoder NeRF stylizes 3D scenes by splitting Instant-NGP into content and style branches, using AdaIN to transfer appearance while preserving geometry via shared MLPs.
